name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source DORA metrics dashboard that measures deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and recovery time from your Git repositories.

alerts.message: Middleware has no login: anyone who can reach the URL can view the metrics and change integrations. Keep the domain private or put it behind an access-controlled proxy.
After the first start, link GitHub or GitLab with a personal access token from the onboarding screen, then pick the repositories to sync.
